title: Attacker-controlled DestUrl posted at send time with no re-validation - SSRF with token exfil (TOCTOU)
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Aditya Mandaleeka / Chris Martinez; component: Webhooks.API/
rationale: Adds send-time egress validation in WebhooksSender: absolute http/https URI required, DNS resolution fail-closed, rejection of loopback/link-local(169.254 incl. cloud metadata)/RFC1918/CGNAT/ULA/multicast and IPv4-mapped-IPv6 forms; switches to a named HttpClient with AllowAutoRedirect=false so a granted public URL cannot 30x into internal targets with the token header attached. One guard covers all three event-handler send paths. RESIDUAL: resolver-level check retains a DNS-rebinding TOCTOU window (full fix needs connection pinning).
variants_checked: Two outbound HTTP sites in Webhooks.API — the sender (fixed) and the grant probe (separate finding f038); SendAll is the single funnel for all three integration handlers.
bypass_considered: Private IPs, metadata endpoints, IPv6 forms, decimal literals, non-http schemes, and redirect pivots are all rejected; DNS rebinding TOCTOU remains as the noted residual.
test_note: SenderSkipsDeliveryToDisallowedDestinations asserts zero requests for private/metadata/loopback/ftp targets; existing test updated to an IP-literal public URL (offline-safe).
review_reason: Validates at the actual egress point with fail-closed resolution and redirect denial; no new surface; the untouched grant probe is a separate residual sink, not an out-of-scope hunk.
